text:
miranda: Heads-up — platform needs request-id propagation into console metrics so dashboards can link traces to per-route latency. Need runtime/infra input.

sam: Happy to help. Are we standardizing on `x-redwood-request-id` or `x-request-id`? runtime currently copies `traceparent` too.

rajesh: Prefer internal `x-redwood-request-id` + accept `x-request-id` from clients. If missing we generate UUID4 at ingress. We'll also emit span attr for it.

alejandra: We should support both W3C `traceparent` and `b3`. Also add header mapping for `x-redwood-request-id` when we create one.

nina: Be careful — adding request_id as Prometheus label will explode cardinality. Don't add request_id to regular metrics. Use it only in traces and logs. For dashboards, surface aggregated trace-rollups or small sample links.

leo: Platform goal: per-route "top errors" chart that links to example traces. Proposed compromise: runtime emits OTLP span attr `redwood.request_id`, Console can call trace-indexer to fetch sample traces. Show a 'trace sample' widget rather than raw IDs in metrics.

tiffany: UX ask: add per-route toggle "capture trace samples" with sampling slider. Default off for prod routes. Also show estimated cost before enabling.

rajesh: Implementation outline:
```
- Add header mapping: accept `traceparent`/`b3`, accept client `x-request-id`, generate `x-redwood-request-id` if absent
- Emit OTLP spans with attribute `redwood.request_id` and `route`
- Add low-cardinality metric label `sample_bucket` not the request id
- Propagate `x-redwood-request-id` in internal gRPC metadata
```

miranda: Action items: runtime to add OTLP attr + header mapping (rajesh, due Fri). Platform to build 'trace sample' widget + per-route toggle (leo, next week). SRE to draft sampling policy and cost estimates (nina). I'll open epics and assign.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PR merged by rajesh: add-request-id-otlp -> staging

rajesh: Note: we'll also add middleware for internal RPCs to carry `x-redwood-request-id` in metadata and set it on outbound requests.

nina: Also request rollout flag to enable per-tenant so we can monitor cost & cardinality before wider roll-out.

sam: Quick question — expected trace storage/cost for beta?

nina: Rough ballpark: 5k traces/day per route -> ~50GB/mo for beta sampling. We'll refine after initial data.

leo: :thumbsup: sounds good. I'll sync with UX on the toggle copy.

miranda: Thanks everyone — will follow up in the epic with links to PRs and design mockups.
